candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway /v1/checkout; traces show payment 503 errors across all sampled correlation IDs while inventory/reservations succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side logs/metrics excluded from budget; root cause within payment (config, saturation) not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are fast (47-94ms) and traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, surfaced by order as 502. Inventory reservations succeed. Bounded candidate is downstream payment failure; payment-internal cause requires excluded logs.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and error metrics for /v1/authorizations to identify why it returns 503
Payment dependency health (postgresql/redis) and resource saturation metrics
